verse.verse_1: By oath of those that sprint, breathing heavily. (The horses used in Holy War.)
verse.verse_2: Striking stones with their hooves, sparking fire.
verse.verse_3: And by oath of those who raid at dawn.
verse.verse_5: Then penetrate to the centre of the enemy army.
verse.verse_6: Indeed man is very ungrateful towards his Lord.
verse.verse_7: And indeed he himself is a witness to it.
verse.verse_8: And indeed he loves wealth to the extreme.
verse.verse_9: So does he not know? When those in the graves are raised,
verse.verse_10: And all what lies in the breasts is opened –
verse.verse_11: On that day their Lord surely knows all about them!
